reviews.comment: Felt like I was just doing the "user experience and survey" part of CSCE315 again but with some p5.js thrown in. Only project descriptions would be a couple bullet points on a random lecture slide. Easiest upper level CS elective I have taken and a kind professor but I can't say I have learned much from the class.
For my dearest, darling, treasured, cherished Jeeeun, whom I worship. With respect, adoration, admiration, kisses, gratitude, best wishes, and love. From S. to J.

Before I walked in the class, I was a boy. Now that I have finished this class, I can strongly say that I am still a boy, just with less braincells. Dr. Kim has managed to make this easy class into a nightmare that never ends. Her assignments have no rubric, very unclear, and always leave the entire class wondering what the assignment even is.

This is one of the most baffling and disorganized classes I've ever taken. Even if you only care about the free A you will be left confused. You will learn nothing. The prof will give you total non-answers to questions in Slack. And yes, the lecture does take the entire 3 hours. Be very patient if you need to take this class, otherwise do not.

The class was severely unorganized and confusing. I have not learned anything with substance in this class. The professor is nice and understand, but fails to provide clear grading guidelines and structure in the class, and states that the lack of organization is for the benefit of the class learning. Easy A tho

Incredibly easy A, but my goodness is this course boring and lacking any organization at all. If you do the work, you will get an A; but you will be confused and frustrated. There is no structure, nor anything practically useful, in this course.

This class is a glorified blow off class. The prof is not good, but the class is easy enough that it doesn't really matter. The prof never gives rubrics, and her grading is as ambiguous as hell. The whole class is basically midterm group projects and homework. The homework is time consuming busy work, but if you do it, you pass easy.

She gives ambiguous expectations for projects (which replace the exams entirely). She answers questions about the requirements by saying she already answered them, and then directs us back to the ambiguous requirements. Luckily she grades rather leniently, but be prepared to be confused and frustrated at times. Also, not sure if I learned anything.

The class was engaging, interesting, and fun. Homework assignments took a while but they weren't difficult. She's an amazing prof who clearly cares about the subject. Grading was unclear at times but as long as you did the work/show up to class you'll do well.

This professor gave me the worst experience Ive ever had in my academic life. Course design was super unorganized. Uses an unorganized slack to handle the class. Uses multiple forms and google docs for a single thing. Did not go in-depth for a single topic. No transparency in grading at all. A total waste of time and energy.
